attribution_cleanup.scope: Neutral attribution wording in commentary, diagnostic output, assessment metadata and score columns. Scores, rating entries, email snapshots, predictions, model weights and security policy are preserved.
attribution_cleanup.historical_records: Original reviewed_sha256, source_cells_sha256, preserved_system_sources.json and full/quick verification source hashes describe the pre-cleanup notebook. Attribution labels in historical diff text and execution-log headings have been normalized.
attribution_cleanup.notebook_file_hash_convention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 notebook bytes with LF line endings, matching the Git blob.

human_rating_presentation_update.saved_output_update: Rating-cell output recomputed from the original and current saved CSVs; final summary display reformatted to report original-snapshot ratings. Current-snapshot counts in raw execution evidence remain unchanged.
